newsitem.title: USA: Ascend agrees to acquire Whitetree Inc.
newsitem.headline: Ascend agrees to acquire Whitetree Inc.

text.p: Ascend Communications Inc on Tuesday said it would acquire Whitetree Inc, a privately held provider of high-speed network switching products, for about 1.1 million shares of common stock.

The number of shares to be issued is subject to change depending on the price of Ascend stock when the deal is closed, but will fall into a range of 970,000 and 1.35 million shares, Ascend said in a statement.
Ascend also completed its acquisition of InterCon Systems Corp for $12 million, plus $9 million in assumed liabilities.
